title: NewCraft+
description: Vanilla Minecraft is boring. Let's fix that!
body:
### 🌿✨ NewCraft+ ✨🌿

A refined Vanilla+ experience for Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric)

NewCraft+ enhances Minecraft without changing what makes it special. It expands exploration, improves visuals, boosts performance, and adds meaningful quality-of-life features — all while preserving the core vanilla survival feel.

If you love Minecraft as it is but want it smoother, richer, and more immersive, this pack is for you.

### 🌍 Enhanced Exploration

Adventure feels bigger and more rewarding while staying balanced.

🏰 Dungeons & Taverns – new immersive structures to discover

🏙️ Towns and Towers – expanded world generation that blends naturally

🚢 Unwrecked Ships Plus – improved ocean exploration

🌲 Geophilic – more organic terrain details

Everything fits seamlessly into vanilla progression.

### ⚡ Optimized Performance

NewCraft+ is built to run smoothly, even on larger worlds.

Includes powerful optimization mods like:

Sodium

Lithium

FerriteCore

ModernFix

EntityCulling & MoreCulling

Expect higher FPS, reduced lag, and better stability — without sacrificing visuals.

### 🌤️ Visual Improvements

Subtle upgrades that make the world feel more alive:

Better Clouds

Wakes (realistic boat water trails)

3D Skin Layers

Better Advancements + search

Optional shader support via Iris

Minecraft — just cleaner, sharper, and more immersive.

### 🛠️ Quality of Life
 
Small improvements that make a big difference:

Mouse Tweaks (faster inventory management)

Shulker Box Tooltip (preview contents)

Enchantment Descriptions

Better HUD elements (armor, effects, info)

Visual Workbench

No unnecessary complexity — just smoother gameplay.

### 🎯 Design Philosophy

NewCraft+ follows a simple rule:

Enhance. Don’t replace.

No tech trees.
No overwhelming progression systems.
No modded overload.

Just Minecraft — polished and expanded the way it feels like it always should have been.
